entries.partTitle: AWS Load Balancer Controller Architecture: CRD Reconcilers, Ingress Groups & IAM OIDC Federation

spec.title: AWS Load Balancer Controller Architecture & CRD Flow
spec.description: Trace how Ingress and TargetGroupBinding manifests trigger automated AWS ALB/TargetGroup provisioning via IRSA.

steps.title: Ingress Controller & IRSA OIDC
steps.description: Controller pod in kube-system authenticates to AWS APIs using fine-grained IRSA OIDC federation.

steps.title: Watch Loops & CRD Reconciliation
steps.description: Watch loop detects Ingress and TargetGroupBinding CRDs, translating specs into AWS ELBv2 calls.

steps.title: TargetGroupBinding Execution
steps.description: Service selectors bind pods directly to external Terraform/CDK-provisioned Target Group ARNs.

steps.title: IngressGroup Multi-Tenant Sharing
steps.description: Multiple namespaces share a unified ALB using 'group.name' annotation to slash infrastructure costs.

entries.partTitle: Target Types Deep Dive: Instance Mode vs Direct Pod IP Mode & The NodePort Double-Hop Elimination

spec.title: Target Types: Instance Mode vs Direct Pod IP Mode
spec.description: Compare packet flow between legacy NodePort double-hop routing and direct Pod VPC ENI addressing.

steps.title: Instance Mode NodePort Hop
steps.description: ALB routes incoming traffic to random EC2 worker node high NodePort (30000-32767).

steps.title: Kube-Proxy Inter-Node Double-Hop
steps.description: Kube-proxy iptables performs DNAT and SNAT, hopping packet across nodes to reach actual pod replica.

steps.title: Direct Pod IP Single Hop
steps.description: Under IP target mode, ALB routes directly across VPC to Pod secondary ENI IP without kube-proxy.

steps.title: Client IP Preservation & Zero Overhead
steps.description: True client IP is preserved in X-Forwarded-For headers with zero thermal load hotspotting.

entries.partTitle: Layer 4 NLB vs Layer 7 ALB Ingress: High-Throughput TLS Termination & Content-Based Path Routing

spec.title: Layer 4 NLB vs Layer 7 ALB Ingress Patterns
spec.description: Analyze protocol handling, TLS termination, ACM wildcard discovery, and HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect actions.

steps.title: NLB Layer 4 Ultra-High Throughput
steps.description: NLB terminates raw TCP/UDP connections with microsecond latency and static Elastic IPs per AZ.

steps.title: ALB Layer 7 Content Routing
steps.description: ALB inspects HTTP paths, headers, and hosts, directing traffic to specialized microservice pod pools.

steps.title: ACM Wildcard Auto-Discovery
steps.description: Controller discovers valid ACM wildcard certificates matching Ingress hostnames without manual ARNs.

steps.title: SSL Redirection Edge Action
steps.description: Port 80 HTTP requests immediately trigger 301 Moved Permanently redirects to port 443 at the ALB edge.

entries.partTitle: VPC Subnet Discovery, Security Group Integration & Pod Readiness Gates

spec.title: VPC Subnet Discovery & Pod Readiness Gates
spec.description: Trace subnet ELB tagging, security group cross-rules, and the target-health.elbv2.k8s.aws gate.

steps.title: Subnet ELB Role Discovery
steps.description: Controller queries AWS EC2 API for 'kubernetes.io/role/elb: 1' tags to allocate ALB interfaces.

steps.title: Security Group Cross-Rules
steps.description: Worker node security groups must allow ingress from the ALB security group on container target ports.

steps.title: Rolling Update Problem
steps.description: Without readiness gates, Kubernetes marks pods ready before ALB health checks pass, causing HTTP 504 errors.

steps.title: Pod Readiness Gate Synchronization
steps.description: Target-health.elbv2.k8s.aws gate holds pod in unready state until AWS Target Group status is healthy.

entries.partTitle: Masterclass Synthesis: Production AWS Load Balancer Controller & TargetGroupBinding Engine

spec.title: Enterprise AWS Load Balancer Controller Engine
spec.description: Comprehensive architectural synthesis of IngressGroup aggregation, direct Pod IP routing, and readiness gates.

steps.title: Edge Ingress Ingestion
steps.description: External client requests hit multi-AZ ALB; TLS 1.3 terminated via ACM wildcard certificates.

steps.title: IngressGroup Path Routing
steps.description: Merged IngressGroup maps paths directly to TargetGroupBinding targets in IP mode.

steps.title: Single-Hop Pod Dispatch
steps.description: Packet delivered directly across VPC to pod secondary ENI IP (100.64.12.8:8080) in 1.6ms.

steps.title: Grade A+ Production Certification
steps.description: Masterclass engine verified with 100% test coverage, zero double-hopping, and zero-downtime rolling updates.
